steps.run: AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); COUNTER_FILE=".github/logs/.edit-count-${SAFE}"; mkdir -p .github/logs; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); case "$COUNT" in ''|*[!0-9]*) COUNT=0;; esac; COUNT=$((COUNT + 1)); echo "$COUNT" > "$COUNTER_FILE"; echo "[REVIEW-TRACK] agent=$SAFE edit_count=$COUNT at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log

mkdir -p .github/logs; AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); COUNTER_FILE=".github/logs/.edit-count-${SAFE}"; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); case "$COUNT" in ''|*[!0-9]*) COUNT=0;; esac; if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then case "$AGENT" in MidCoderAlpha|MidCoderBeta) REVIEWER="StaffEngineerAlpha or StaffEngineerBeta (T2 Staff Engineer)";; StaffEngineerAlpha|StaffEngineerBeta) REVIEWER="PrincipalAlpha or PrincipalBeta (T1 Principal)";; AnalystAlpha|AnalystBeta|AnalystGamma) REVIEWER="LeadAnalyst (T4 Lead Analyst)";; LeadAnalyst) REVIEWER="PrincipalAlpha or PrincipalBeta (T1 Principal)";; PrincipalAlpha|PrincipalBeta) REVIEWER="Final authority — self-verified";; *) REVIEWER="Orchestrator routes review";; esac; echo ""; echo "[REVIEW] ======================================="; echo "[REVIEW]  REVIEW REQUIRED"; echo "[REVIEW]  Agent: $AGENT made $COUNT file edit(s)"; echo "[REVIEW]  Reviewer: $REVIEWER"; echo "[REVIEW] ======================================="; echo ""; echo "[REVIEW-SUMMARY] agent=$SAFE edits=$COUNT reviewer=$REVIEWER at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi; rm -f "$COUNTER_FILE"

AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); rm -f ".github/logs/.edit-count-${SAFE}" 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p .github/logs; echo "[REVIEW-ERROR] agent=$SAFE counter cleaned at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log
